name: steve-pay
description: Steve Pay — a card-transfer payment gateway for Iranian banks, running entirely on Cloudflare's edge.

scripts.predev: npm run fonts && npm run assets
scripts.build: npm run fonts && npm run assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: npm run fonts && npm run assets && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run fonts && npm run assets && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply steve-pay-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply steve-pay --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute steve-pay --remote --env production --file seeds/0001_settings.sql
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
